publication.title: iPhone OS Research Atlas
publication.scope: iPhone OS 1.1.4 / 4A102 and 3.1.3 / 7E18; native PinePhone execution, distinct QEMU gates and offline next-target study
publication.provenance: Original editorial synthesis of private project notebooks and experiment reports, with reviewed capture images, selected source excerpts and their provenance. Firmware, storage images, complete run artifacts and the implementation repository are not included.
publication.author: Felipe Sabino

record.title: Ranked next targets are an offline study
record.method: Actual selected firmware inspection; kernel and renderer control-flow checks
record.observation: The study conditionally ranks 3GS iOS 6.1.6 ahead of iPhone 5 iOS 10.3.4 and 5s/6 iOS 12.5.7. The selected kernels use 4 KiB pages, but fresh keybags, new bindings and display execution remain gates.
record.limits: A static software-renderer route is not runtime UI acceptance. The inspected 5s renderer does not independently establish the iPhone 6 renderer. Modern SEP/keybag contracts are not supplied by the current explicit-key AES service.

exhibits.title: Reviewed acceptance boundaries
rows: The study conditionally ranks 3GS iOS 6.1.6 ahead of iPhone 5 iOS 10.3.4 and 5s/6 iOS 12.5.7. The selected kernels use 4 KiB pages, but fresh keybags, new bindings and display execution remain gates.

A static software-renderer route is not runtime UI acceptance. The inspected 5s renderer does not independently establish the iPhone 6 renderer. Modern SEP/keybag contracts are not supplied by the current explicit-key AES service.
